purpose: Automatic learning layer for Confluence of Minds content performance. Updated by the weekly performance analyst and read by the autonomous editor before future publishing decisions.

site_analytics.note: No Google Analytics, Plausible, Umami, Matomo, GoatCounter or equivalent tracker is connected. Website visits, click-through, owned-audience conversion and SEO conversion must not be inferred from social data.

scoring_model.principle: Compare posts primarily against other CoM posts from a similar recent period. Historical 2024 data is directional only and carries lower confidence than post-2026 autonomous-editor data.

dimensions.discovery: Relative reach and views. High reach with low interaction means awareness, not resonance.
dimensions.resonance: Engagement rate plus saves, shares and comments normalized by reach. Saves/shares/comments are stronger signals than likes alone.
dimensions.growth: Follows or subscribers attributed to the post, normalized by reach. Treat very small denominators cautiously.
dimensions.retention: Average watch time, 3-second hold or equivalent, completion rate and viewed-duration ratio when available.
dimensions.creative_quality: Hook specificity, first-frame strength, authored visual identity, variation in hook grammar, avoidance of generic generated filler and platform-native execution.
dimensions.overall: Weighted relative judgment across discovery, resonance, growth, retention and creative quality. Do not use one composite score without displaying confidence and post count.

confidence.low: 1-2 comparable posts or mostly historical data

historical_baseline.reason: Most comparable Instagram history predates the 2026 relaunch and current autonomous publishing system.

signals.learning: Generic umbrella-brand awareness can generate views without generating interaction.
Specific cultural concepts with a clear curiosity hook can outperform generic project promotion on resonance.
Educational and cultural adjacency around an existing world is a promising editorial mode.
Shattered Dragons historically showed strong resonance inside a small audience.
Narrative fragments with a concrete creature or worldbuilding idea can be efficient engagement assets.
Broad contradiction or activism posts can attract some exposure but may fail to generate interaction.
Memetic content may produce discovery without meaningful resonance.

rows.discovery: strongest cross-platform discovery of the mature tests, especially YouTube and Facebook
rows.retention: weak for a 17.5 s cut: Instagram avg watch 2.51 s and 20% 3-second hold; TikTok avg watch 3.47 s
rows.resonance: low overall; 1 Instagram like, 4 Facebook likes, no shares or comments
rows.growth: one Facebook follower acquired on the publication day; no attributable Instagram/TikTok/YouTube conversion
rows.learning: Keep the concrete factual contradiction but recut to 6-9 s and strengthen the first visual beat. Do not repeat the 17.5 s trailer-style execution.

rows.retention: better than Titan after shortening to 12 s: Instagram avg watch 3.70 s and 35% 3-second hold; TikTok avg watch 5.37 s
rows.resonance: one Instagram save, otherwise no comments or shares
rows.growth: no measured follower or subscriber gain
rows.learning: The idea may be sound but the execution is not earning distribution. Shorten further and make the first frame itself prove the sound-cinema idea instead of relying on a question or trailer framing.

rows.discovery: promising on TikTok: 251 views versus 82-83 for the two prior tests; weak/too-fresh evidence elsewhere
rows.retention: TikTok avg watch 3.71 s on an 8 s video, materially better as a share of duration than Titan and similar to SILMEA
rows.resonance: no measured reactions, comments or shares yet
rows.learning: This is the strongest signal for the 6-9 s concept-first format, but one platform result with zero propagation is not enough to SCALE the world. Test descendants with a more concrete visual payoff and less abstract question wording.

heatmap.note: Current evidence is too small for world-level winners. The useful signal is executional: shorter concept-first cuts improve retention, while concrete factual hooks currently distribute better on YouTube/Facebook.

learning_rules: Never optimize solely for views or reach.
Separate discovery from resonance, retention and conversion/growth.
Use recent post cohorts preferentially; downweight old history as current data accumulates.
Do not draw strong conclusions from a single viral or tiny-reach post.
Never kill a world from one weak post; mutate the creative execution first when the underlying concept remains plausible.
Avoid repetitive generic question hooks such as consecutive What if, Why or Can formulations.
At least half of new tests should be composed as native social-first creative rather than simple vertical reframes of archive trailers until visual-quality evidence improves.
Do not claim generic AI-looking visuals, crude charts or template-motion problems unless visual inspection verifies them; metadata alone is not enough.
Do not claim website or SEO performance until a web analytics source is actually connected.

recent_autonomous_tests.learning: Concrete contradiction works better for discovery than the more abstract tests, but the 17.5 s execution loses viewers early. Preserve the premise and rebuild the cut.
Shortening improved retention, but the concept and first-frame package did not earn distribution. Rebuild around a direct sensory proof, not another generic question card.
TikTok distribution is roughly 3x the prior two-test baseline and retention as a share of duration is materially better, but there is still zero propagation and cross-platform evidence is incomplete.

volume.note: The 30-day autonomous context is effectively the same as the current window because the new cross-platform loop began on 18 September.

instagram.conversion: No attributable follows in post-level data. Total follower count moved from 1043 to 1044 around the Titan publication, but attribution is unavailable.

tiktok.learning: 8-12 s cuts retain a much larger share of duration than the 17.5 s Titan cut. RALUVAAA received 251 views but no propagation.

youtube.learning: Titan is a clear distribution outlier; concrete science-fact framing currently fits YouTube better than abstract project-premise questions, but retention data is unavailable.

facebook.learning: The concrete Titan fact substantially outperformed the abstract/audio SILMEA concept.

main_family_decisions.reason: Weak early hold and no propagation. Shorter cuts materially improve viewed-duration ratio.
Promising TikTok signal from RALUVAAA, but only one comparable test and zero interactions.
Best discovery on Titan across YouTube/Facebook/Instagram; needs a shorter execution before scaling.
Current and queued angles overuse Can/What if/Why grammar, which risks making the feed feel templated and automated.

strongest_patterns: Concrete surprising facts distribute better than abstract project explanations on YouTube and Facebook.
Shortening from 17.5 s to 12 s and 8 s materially improves watch time as a share of video length on TikTok.
RALUVAAA is the first recent concept to reach roughly 3x the prior TikTok view baseline, but without shares, comments or follows yet.
weakest_patterns: No recent post has generated a share or comment across the measured channels.
Abstract question hooks are becoming repetitive: SILMEA uses Can, RALUVAAA and the queued Katephomi test use What if, and the queued Snow White test uses Why.
The current creative stream is dominated by archive-remix vertical reframes, which creates a structural risk of template repetition even though the available analytics do not permit direct visual QA.

hook_visual_quality_learnings.hook: Use more declarative contradictions, sensory instructions, reveals, fragments and visual-first openings. Generic questions should be a minority, not the default grammar.
hook_visual_quality_learnings.first_frame: Titan's 20% Instagram 3-second hold and SILMEA's 35% show the opening still needs work. The first frame should carry the idea without needing a title-card setup.
hook_visual_quality_learnings.visual_quality: No reliable frame-level inspection was available in this review, so no claim is made that recent assets contain generic gradients, crude charts or obvious AI filler. However, repeated archive reframes are a credible consistency risk and should be diluted with native social-first compositions.

owned_audience_monetization.outreach: No qualified outreach actions logged yet.
owned_audience_monetization.social_growth: One Facebook follower acquired on the Titan publication day; no measured TikTok/YouTube growth and no post-attributed Instagram follow.

measurement_notes: Metricool is the primary source but had not ingested the 20 September RALUVAAA Instagram Reel at review time.
Metricool returned no YouTube published-video rows for the period, so Buffer was used as secondary evidence for YouTube views.
For SILMEA Instagram, Buffer reported higher reach/views than Metricool. Use Metricool for decisions but keep confidence low until the feeds converge.

next_allocation.duration: Prefer 6-9 s for discovery tests; use longer cuts only when the content earns the extra time.
next_allocation.hook_mix: At least two thirds declarative, visual-first, fragment, contradiction or reveal openings; at most one third generic question openings.

platform_bias.tiktok: More 6-9 s concept-first tests with a concrete payoff and explicit shareability.
platform_bias.youtube: Favor factual surprise, concrete reveals and searchable concepts over abstract world descriptions.
platform_bias.facebook: Keep selective factual/science/culture hooks; do not mirror every creative automatically if fit is weak.
platform_bias.instagram: Test short native first frames that combine Titan-level discovery specificity with SILMEA-level retention improvement.

weekly_snapshots.strategic_decision: No positioning pivot yet. Volume is far too small and there was no comparable previous-week publishing cohort. Make a creative-execution reallocation now, then reconsider positioning only after enough comparable tests accumulate without a true breakout.

amplify: platform-specific packaging instead of identical cross-post framing
mutate: 17.5 s Titan cut while preserving the fact hook
generic What if / Why / Can question grammar
archive trailer reframes that begin with title-card logic
deprioritize: long trailer-style cuts without early retention evidence
abstract project explanation before visual payoff
repeating the same interrogative hook rhythm across consecutive posts
hold: RALUVAAA as a world-level winner until more platforms and propagation signals confirm it
platform reallocation decisions until more than 2-3 comparable posts exist
